context: Two constraint types in one payload: a closed enum and a count-bounded collection. Predicted baseline failure: the agent writes one accepted case per enum value and forgets the unknown-value rejection path entirely - the exact gap the team already noticed when a removed method broke nothing - and treats the collection bound as a single 'empty basket' case rather than probing either limit. The skill's value is that each constraint type has a standard case set applied without being asked.

checklist.name: Test file created
checklist.description: A file src/shipment.test.js exists and contains at least one test.

checklist.name: Every enum value accepted
checklist.description: All three declared methods - standard, express, pickup - are each exercised in an accepting case. Covering only one or two caps this at half.

checklist.name: Unknown enum value rejected
checklist.description: MUST include the rejection path. At least one case supplies a method outside the declared set and asserts UNKNOWN_METHOD. Omitting this scores zero on this criterion - it is the specific coverage gap the task describes, and a suite without it stays green when a method is silently removed.

checklist.name: Lower item-count bound covered on all three points
checklist.description: Item counts 0 (TOO_FEW_ITEMS), 1 (accepted), and 2 (accepted) are each exercised. Missing the count-2 point caps this at half; missing two of the three scores zero.

checklist.name: Upper item-count bound covered on all three points
checklist.description: Item counts 49 (accepted), 50 (accepted), and 51 (TOO_MANY_ITEMS) are each exercised, with the large baskets built programmatically rather than written out by hand. Missing the count-49 point caps this at half; missing two of the three scores zero.

checklist.name: One test per case
checklist.description: MUST NOT bundle the enum set or the count set into a single test containing many assertions. Cases are separate tests, or generated per-case by a loop or parameterised helper that yields individually named cases. A single mega-test scores zero here.

checklist.name: Specific rejection codes asserted
checklist.description: Failing cases assert the exact code - TOO_FEW_ITEMS, TOO_MANY_ITEMS, UNKNOWN_METHOD, ITEMS_NOT_ARRAY - rather than only that ok is false. Asserting only falsiness scores zero here, since the validator checks item count before method and a wrong-reason result would still pass.
